name: Shabby The Narwhal
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may search the deck for a Downgrade card and add it to your hand. Shuffle the deck.

name: Re-Target
description: Move and Upgrade or Downgrade card from any player's Stable to any other player's Stable.

name: Reset Button
description: Each player must SACRIFICE all Upgrade and Downgrade cards. Shuffle the discard pile into the deck.

name: Targeted Destruction
description: SACRIFICE or DESTROY an Upgrade or Downgrade card.

name: Caffeine Overload
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may SACRIFICE a card, then DRAW 2 cards.

name: Claw Machine
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD card, then DRAW a card.

name: Double Dutch
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may play 2 cards during your Action phase.

name: Glitter Bomb
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may SACRIFICE a card. If you do, DESTROY a card.

name: Rainbow Aura
description: Your Unicorn cards cannot be destroyed.

name: Rainbow Lasso
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD 3 cards, then STEAL a Unicorn card.

name: Stable Artillery
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD 2 cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card.

name: Yay
description: Cards you play cannot be Neigh'd

name: Barbed Wire
description: Each time a Unicorn card enters or leaves your Stable, DISCARD a card.

name: Pandamonium
description: All of your Unicorns are considered Pandas. Cards that affect Unicorn cards do not affect your Pandas.

name: Sadistic Ritual
description: If this card is in yoru Stable at the beginning of yoru turn, SACRIFICE a Unicorn card, then DRAW a card.

name: Slowdown
description: You cannot play Instant cards.

name: Nanny Cam
description: Your hand must be visible to all players at all times.

name: Broken Stable
description: You cannot play Upgrade cards.

name: Blinding Light
description: Triggered effects of your Unicorn cards do not activate.

name: Tiny Stable
description: If at any time you have mor than 5 Unicorns in your Stable, SACRIFICE a Unicorn card.

name: Neigh
description: Play this card when another player tries to play a card. Stop their card from being played and send it to the discard pile.

name: Super Neigh
description: Play this card when any other player tries to play a card. Stop that player's card from being played and send it to the discard pile. This card cannot be Neigh'd.
